Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
We don’t have a self-serve way to add items onto an order that’s already been placed (it depends on whether the order has been released to the manufacturer/warehouse).

Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
menu
In most cases, separate orders can’t be combined into one shipment—many items ship directly from the manufacturer/distributor, and it’s normal for items (and even items within the same order) to ship from different locations with separate tracking.
If you tell us the two order numbers, our team can check what’s still possible based on where each order is in processing (especially if nothing has been released to ship yet).
